article.title: вот como marcador de límite discursivo: hallazgo de corpus
article.part: Pragmática y registro — Прагматика и регистр
article.chapter: Partículas coloquiales y pragmática — Разговорные частицы и прагматика

claims.summary: Bogdanova-Beglarian et al. (2019) report pilot annotation of pragmatic markers in two Russian speech corpora, ORD dialogues and SAT monologues; the findings are scoped to the samples studied.
In the ORD dialogue sample, вот was the most frequent pragmatic marker (149 cases) and was usually coded as a boundary marker G.

In the SAT monologue sample, вот/ну вот, значит and так occur among frequent G boundary markers, which the authors describe as marking monologue beginnings/endings or navigating the text; G is distinct from K, a xeno-indicator introducing someone’s speech.

locator.description: pp. 72–73 (Russian and English abstracts): two corpora, four pilot annotation rounds, corpus/sample scope, and summary conclusions.
